summary: Woodward, Inc. filed an 8-K on August 21, 2026, disclosing a Note Purchase Agreement dated August 19, 2026 with named purchasers for $450 million of senior unsecured notes sold in a private placement: $150 million Series U due September 30, 2029 at 5.34%; $150 million Series V due September 30, 2030 at 5.39%; and $150 million Series W due September 30, 2033 at 5.64%, each stepping up 75 basis points if debt-to-EBITDA exceeds 3.5x. Closing is scheduled September 30, 2026; interest pays semi-annually from March 30, 2027. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation; watch covenant headroom and leverage triggers.
